label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: TGL Renews ESPN Deal
items.text: Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy's TGL golf simulator league will return to ESPN for Season 3 in 2027 with Brooks Koepka joining the seven-team field starting Dec. 27.

items.headline: Tiger Praises Presidents Cup
items.text: Tiger Woods congratulated Team USA on their 17-13 victory at the Presidents Cup in a recent social media message.

items.headline: Reed Favored Over Bryson
items.text: Brendon de Jonge claims Patrick Reed is considerably more likely than Bryson DeChambeau to make the American Ryder Cup team at Adare Manor.
